concept.title: Syncs List
concept.shortdesc: The Syncs list shows all sync configurations in your organization and provides the starting point for creating, viewing, and managing syncs.

conbody.p: Click Syncs in the navigation menu to open the Syncs list. Each row in the table represents one sync configuration and displays the following information:

dlentry.dd: The descriptive name you assigned to the sync when you created it.
The source system the sync reads content from. Currently, the only supported adapter is Heretto Deploy.
The target system the sync publishes content to, for example Salesforce Knowledge.
The human-readable description of when the sync runs automatically, or Manual sync only if no automatic schedule is configured.
Whether the sync is active or inactive.

conbody.p: Click any row to open the Sync Detail page for that sync. Click New Sync to create a new sync configuration.
conbody.note: If the list is empty, no syncs have been created yet. Click New Sync to set one up.
